description:
Signs in an anonymous (guest) account with its stored anonymousToken and starts a player session (accessToken).
Use when: a returning guest opens the game, or right after horizon_signup_anonymous, before any tool that needs sessionToken.
Not for: email accounts (use horizon_signin_email) or creating a guest (use horizon_signup_anonymous).
Requires: the anonymousToken returned by horizon_signup_anonymous for this account.
Side effects: creates a new session on every call; older sessions stay valid.
Returns: {userId, username, accessToken, authStatus, message}, plus refreshToken and both expiry timestamps only when explicitly opted in. Pass accessToken as sessionToken. Store recovery and refresh tokens in platform secure storage, never logs or general preferences.
Errors: 404 USER_NOT_FOUND means this token cannot restore the account: confirm the stored token and offer horizon_signup_anonymous only after the player chooses a new account. 429 may also be the configured project/IP or project/token limiter: honor Retry-After instead of assuming fixed limits. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

anonymousToken.description: anonymousToken returned by horizon_signup_anonymous (exactly 32 characters: letters, digits, _ and -)

includeRefreshToken.description: Explicit opt-in to a rotating 30-day refresh session; omitted or false preserves access-only behavior. Store refresh tokens in platform secure storage

name: horizon_signin_anonymous
title: Sign In Anonymously
